dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.platform.adapters.adapt>
<!description: Replace direct cast to IAdaptable and getAdapter() with Adapters.adapt() for safer adaptation, avoiding ClassCastException where object does not directly implement IAdaptable but can adapt to resource type.>
<!severity: WARNING>
((org.eclipse.core.runtime.IAdaptable) $var).getAdapter($class.class)
=> org.eclipse.core.runtime.Adapters.adapt($var, $class.class)
;;
summary: Replaces `((IAdaptable) $var).getAdapter($class.class)` with `Adapters.adapt($var, $class.class)` for safer type adaptation.
